result.instructions: Tools for Tenant Inc, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of our properties have the most available units right now?"; "Show the management summary for our Main Street property for yesterday."; "List the leases that moved out in the last 30 days.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Tenant Inc data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run tenantinc_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run tenantinc_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run tenantinc_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. tenantinc_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: tenantinc_list_properties
tools.title: List properties
tools.description: List the properties (self-storage sites) of the company, with their ids. Good first call to find a property_id. GET /v1/companies/{company_id}/properties/.

tools.name: tenantinc_get_property
tools.title: Get a property
tools.description: Get one property with its address and settings. GET /v1/companies/{company_id}/properties/{property_id}.

tools.name: tenantinc_list_units
tools.title: List units in a property
tools.description: List the units of one property (size, status, rate). GET /v1/companies/{company_id}/properties/{property_id}/units.

grouping_profile_id.description: Hashed grouping profile id (groups the units).

concise.description: Return the smaller item shape with larger pages.

offset.description: Rows to skip before the first row returned.

tools.name: tenantinc_list_available_units
tools.title: List available units
tools.description: List the units of one property that are free to rent now. GET /v1/companies/{company_id}/properties/{property_id}/units/available.

offset.description: Number of units to skip before the first one returned.

tools.name: tenantinc_get_unit
tools.title: Get a unit
tools.description: Get one unit by its hashed id, with its size and rate. GET /v1/companies/{company_id}/units/{unit_id}.

tools.name: tenantinc_list_leases
tools.title: List leases
tools.description: List leases by status (active, inactive, future or all), optionally for one property and a start-date window. GET /v1/companies/{company_id}/leases/.

status.description: Lease period to return. Default: the API default.

from_date.description: Start date on or after this day.

to_date.description: Start date on or before this day. Needs from_date.

concise.description: Return the smaller item shape with larger pages.

offset.description: Rows to skip before the first row returned.

tools.name: tenantinc_get_lease
tools.title: Get a lease
tools.description: Get one lease with its unit, dates and rent. GET /v1/companies/{company_id}/leases/{lease_id}.

tools.name: tenantinc_get_lease_ledger
tools.title: Get a lease ledger
tools.description: Get the charges and payments on one lease (the ledger). GET /v1/companies/{company_id}/leases/{lease_id}/ledger.

tools.name: tenantinc_list_move_outs
tools.title: List move-outs
tools.description: List leases that ended, by end date. Use days alone for the last N days, or from_date and to_date. GET /v1/companies/{company_id}/leases/move-out.

from_date.description: End date on or after this day.

to_date.description: End date on or before this day. Needs from_date.

concise.description: Return the smaller item shape with larger pages.

offset.description: Rows to skip before the first row returned.

tools.name: tenantinc_list_tenants
tools.title: List tenants
tools.description: List tenants on leases, optionally for one property. GET /v1/companies/{company_id}/tenants.

property_id.description: Only tenants on leases at this property.

offset.description: Rows to skip before the first row returned.

tools.name: tenantinc_get_contact
tools.title: Get a contact
tools.description: Get one contact (a tenant or lead) by id. GET /v1/companies/{company_id}/contacts/{contact_id}.

tools.name: tenantinc_list_reservations
tools.title: List active reservations
tools.description: List active unit reservations, optionally for one property. GET /v1/companies/{company_id}/reservations/.

tools.name: tenantinc_list_promotions
tools.title: List promotions
tools.description: List promotions (discounts), optionally for one property. GET /v1/companies/{company_id}/promotions/.

property_id.description: Only promotions assigned to this property.

tools.name: tenantinc_get_management_summary
tools.title: Get the management summary
tools.description: Get the management summary for one property on one day: daily, month-to-date and year-to-date figures. GET /v1/companies/{company_id}/reports/management-summary.

tools.name: tenantinc_get_property_management_summary
tools.title: Get a property's management summary
tools.description: Get the management summary for one property on one day, from the property endpoint. GET /v1/companies/{company_id}/properties/{property_id}/reports/management-summary.

tools.name: tenantinc_get_daily_deposits
tools.title: Get daily deposits
tools.description: Get the deposits (payments taken) for one property on one day. GET /v1/companies/{company_id}/reports/daily-deposits.

tools.name: tenantinc_get_rental_activity
tools.title: Get rental activity
tools.description: Get the rentals (move-ins and changes) for one property over a date range. GET /v1/companies/{company_id}/reports/rental-activity.

date.description: First day of the period, yyyy-mm-dd.

end_date.description: Last day of the period, included, yyyy-mm-dd.

tools.name: tenantinc_get_occupancy_report
tools.title: Get the occupancy report
tools.description: Get the occupancy statistics for one property on one day, broken down by a space grouping profile. GET /v1/companies/{company_id}/properties/{property_id}/reports/occupancy-statistics-report.

date.description: The report day, yyyy-mm-dd (not after today, UTC).

space_group_id.description: Space grouping profile id (from the property's space-groups).

prompts.name: find_units_ready_to_rent_at_a_property

prompts.description: List the properties to find a property id. Then list the units of that property that are available to rent now.

prompts.name: review_a_lease_and_its_ledger
prompts.title: Review a lease and its ledger
prompts.description: Open one lease for its unit, dates and rent. Read its ledger of charges and payments to check for unpaid charges.

prompts.name: list_move_outs_and_tenants
prompts.title: List move-outs and tenants
prompts.description: List leases that ended in the last days or in a date range. List the tenants on the leases of one property.

prompts.name: read_the_management_summary_for_one_day

prompts.description: Read the management summary of a property for one day, with daily, month-to-date and year-to-date figures. Read the deposits taken that day.

prompts.name: track_rental_activity_and_occupancy
prompts.title: Track rental activity and occupancy
prompts.description: Read the move-ins and changes for a property over a date range. Read the occupancy statistics of a property for one day.
